notes: Two small honesty fixes in the portfolio. A stop-loss sitting exactly at your buy price used to print '(-0.0%)' — it now says '(at buy price)', and a stop lifted above your buy by the break-even rule now says '+X% above buy — profit locked' instead of wearing a minus sign. And the Auto-pilot's 'last decision' line now shows its full sentence, wrapping onto a second line when needed, rather than being shortened.
